content.text:
I built `index.html` as a single file with DOM cells and a `window.__tetris` API that runs the same `gravityStep` as the real timer. I only checked that the script parses; I haven't run the game in a browser. When a piece can't fall, soft drop does nothing and the next gravity step locks it. `next` always holds at least 5 pieces: your queue first, then random pieces from a shuffled set of all seven. `tick()` restarts the real timer so it doesn't add extra steps during a test.
Rules for later: the board cells are the only `data-testid="cell"` elements (the next-piece preview doesn't use it), and colours come from `[data-piece]` CSS rules.
I left out rotation, a hold piece and points for drops because they weren't asked for.
